resources.inspiration: 研究假设：对相同IBQ ID和Qwen3主干，保留统一图文序列，只切换causal next-token与joint MASK恢复；用文字/图像相互inpainting检验双向信息调用，并检查OCR glyph和稀有code是否在高mask率下丢失。
resources.experiment: 固定Qwen3、IBQ、图文数据、参数与训练FLOPs，比较AR、absorbing-MASK、URSA metric path。各自扫描相同总forward预算与CFG；报告OCRBench/DocVQA/TextVQA、生成文字OCR、GenEval、inpainting、code coverage、NFE/吞吐/显存；把理解输入codec与采样器收益拆开。
resources.state: text IDs与离散visual code IDs联合序列；前向随机将位置变为absorbing MASK，模型内部embedding连续不等于连续生成状态。视觉decoder负责ID到像素，非VAE latent Gaussian diffusion。
resources.objective: 在被mask位置学习clean token的categorical logits/交叉熵式离散去噪目标，非ELF velocity/noise/average velocity。与URSA同为离散端点，但MASK corruption不利用完整视觉metric path。
resources.decoding: 并行迭代unmask，可变步数控制速度质量，保留输入位置可做联合inpainting。论文含115M/340M及1.4B尺度；小尺度使用300 L40S GPU小时的离散模型训练对照，不能作为Qwen3端到端预算。统一评测NFE与完整训练FLOPs本次未核验。
resources.sharing: 统一Transformer处理图文离散token，但文本与图像各有tokenizer及词表区间；不意味着text/image codec或所有head绑权。论文强调同tokenizer AR对照；Qwen3初始化迁移需独立验证，不与从零训练结论混写。
resources.open: 官方代码仓库及训练/推理实现可访问，论文声明公开模型和数据；完整数据下载与所有权重本次未逐项运行核验。精读方法、AR对照/CFG及附录预算；属于2025基础补录，非今日新发表。

english.summary: Jointly models discrete text/image tokens with random masking and bidirectional denoising for generation,captioning,retrieval and cross-modal inpainting. Variable-budget joint modeling is the contribution; early caption/retrieval results do not establish specialist OCR/VQA capability.
english.why: An essential masked baseline for a discrete-UMM paper. Place Qwen3+IBQ AR,MaskGIT-style recovery and URSA metric paths on the same axes. Fix tokenizer and CFG so guidance is not mistaken for a paradigm gain.
english.inspiration: Hypothesis: retain the same IBQ IDs,Qwen3 backbone and joint sequence; switch causal next-token prediction to joint masked recovery. Test bidirectional use with text/image inpainting,including glyph and rare-code retention at high mask rates.
english.state: Joint text IDs and discrete visual-code IDs. Random absorbing-MASK corruption; continuous internal embeddings do not make the modeled state continuous. An image decoder maps IDs to pixels,without Gaussian VAE-latent generation.
english.objective: Predicts clean categorical token logits at masked positions with a discrete denoising objective,not ELF velocity/noise/average velocity. Like URSA it has discrete endpoints,but masking does not exploit the full visual metric path.
english.decoding: Parallel iterative unmasking supports variable quality/compute and constrained inpainting. Paper includes115M/340M and1.4B models; a small-scale setup uses300L40S GPU-hours,not a Qwen end-to-end budget. Complete training FLOPs/common-evaluation NFE not verified in this audit.
english.sharing: A joint Transformer processes text/image token regions,but their tokenizers and vocabulary ranges differ; shared modeling does not imply one codec or tied modality heads. Same-tokenizer AR comparisons are central. Qwen initialization is a proposed transfer,not a reported result.
english.experiment: Fix Qwen3,IBQ,data,parameters and training FLOPs; compare AR,absorbing MASK and URSA metric paths. Sweep equal total-forward budgets/CFG and report OCRBench,DocVQA,TextVQA,generated-text OCR,GenEval,inpainting,code coverage,NFE,throughput and memory. Separate input-codec gains from sampling.
english.open: Official code and training/inference implementation accessible; paper announces models/data. Complete downloads and every checkpoint were not executed here. Read method,AR/CFG comparisons and budget appendix. A2025 foundational backfill,not a new publication.

resources.title: MMaDA: Multimodal Large Diffusion Language Models
resources.summary: 从LLaDA-8B-Instruct扩展统一masked diffusion，用MAGVIT-v2离散图像token联合文本推理、视觉理解与T2I；随后Mixed-CoT和UniGRPO进一步后训练。应把共享概率模型与CoT/RL奖励带来的提升分开。
resources.why: 是Qwen3+IBQ离散UMM必须覆盖的LLM出发masked基线，可与AR→URSA改造直接比较。论文的跨任务能力同时依赖数据和RL，不能只凭最终分数声称masked目标优于AR。
resources.inspiration: 研究假设：先用Qwen3与IBQ做不加CoT/RL的基础masked适配，再独立加Mixed-CoT与统一reward。用OCR证据替换/删除测试解释是否忠实，生成文字OCR与code diversity不能被语言奖励掩盖。
resources.experiment: 固定主干/IBQ/训练数据/FLOPs，先比较AR、MaskGIT式图像mask+text AR、全图文mask、URSA。最佳结构上再做CoT×RL的2×2控制；报OCRBench/DocVQA/TextVQA、GenEval、生成文字、palette、语言保持及全部rollout/reward成本。
resources.state: 文本用LLaDA tokenizer，图像用Show-o采用的MAGVIT-v2离散quantizer，映射到统一token序列；前向随机mask目标token并保留prompt。不是共享一个图文encoder，也不是连续VAE噪声状态。
resources.objective: 统一clean-token masked prediction，加Mixed-CoT SFT与UniGRPO。输出仍为categorical logits；UniGRPO通过多mask估计概率，非ELF连续velocity目标，也不等于URSA uniform metric kernel。
resources.decoding: 官方示例文本使用semi-AR block sampling，图像/多模态使用非AR迭代去噪；“全diffusion”不等于所有任务同一全局解码顺序。初始化LLaDA而非直接AR；完整训练FLOPs及各任务统一NFE本次未核验，需从配置逐项记录。
resources.sharing: 图文共dLLM主干和masked概率形式，但MAGVIT图像codec与文本tokenizer分开。为Qwen迁移时应保留原词表/IBQ head的对照，单独报告adapter、扩词表与双向attention改动，不把继承LLaDA能力算新范式收益。
resources.open: 官方training/models/evaluation代码与Base、MixCoT模型链接可访问；README的Max/UniGRPO最终模型仍写coming soon，不能笼统称所有阶段权重已公开。精读概率目标、sampling与UniGRPO，补录历史核心文献。

english.summary: Extends LLaDA-8B-Instruct with MAGVIT-v2 image IDs for masked-diffusion text reasoning,visual understanding and T2I,followed by Mixed-CoT and UniGRPO. Separate the joint probabilistic model from data,CoT and reward gains.
english.why: A mandatory LLM-initialized masked baseline for Qwen3+IBQ discrete UMM and AR-to-URSA adaptation. Final capabilities also depend on data/RL; final scores alone do not establish masked-objective superiority over AR.
english.inspiration: Hypothesis: first adapt Qwen3+IBQ without CoT/RL,then add Mixed-CoT and rewards separately. Test evidence substitution/deletion for OCR explanation faithfulness; audit generated-text OCR and code diversity beyond language rewards.
english.state: LLaDA text tokenizer plus Show-o MAGVIT-v2 discrete image quantizer in one sequence. Target tokens are randomly masked while prompts remain. Neither one image/text encoder nor Gaussian VAE states.
english.objective: Unified masked clean-token prediction,then Mixed-CoT SFT and UniGRPO. Outputs remain categorical logits; multimask probability estimation for RL is not ELF velocity or a URSA uniform metric corruption kernel.
english.decoding: Official demo uses semi-AR block text sampling and non-AR image/multimodal denoising. Fully diffusion-based does not mean identical global decoding for every task. Initializes LLaDA rather than directly converting AR. Complete FLOPs/common NFE require task-config auditing.
english.sharing: Text/images share the dLLM backbone and masked formulation,but use separate text tokenizer and image codec. For Qwen transfer,control adapters,vocabulary expansion,IBQ heads and bidirectional attention separately; inherited LLaDA ability is not a new modeling gain.
english.experiment: Fix backbone,IBQ,data and FLOPs; compare AR,text-AR/image-mask,fully masked text/image and URSA. On a fixed best architecture,cross CoT and RL in a2x2 design. Report OCRBench,DocVQA,TextVQA,GenEval,text rendering,palette,language retention and every rollout/reward cost.
english.open: Official training,models,evaluation code plus Base/MixCoT checkpoint links accessible. README still labels final Max/UniGRPO checkpoint coming soon; not every stage is released. Read objective,sampling and UniGRPO. Historical core backfill.

resources.title: FUDOKI: Discrete Flow-based Unified Understanding and Generation via Kinetic-Optimal Velocities
resources.paradigm: Metric-Induced Discrete Flow / Kinetic-Optimal Rates / AR Initialization
resources.summary: 以Janus-1.5B的AR统一模型初始化，切换到全attention与离散flow matching，利用metric-induced probability path和kinetic-optimal velocities实现双向上下文及可纠错迭代。它是比普通mask更直接的URSA相关工作。
resources.why: 若ICML工作强调离散metric path、从Qwen/AR适配或迭代纠错，FUDOKI是不能遗漏的近邻。必须区分已有的path/velocity参数化与自己的共享表示、局部head或训练效率贡献。
resources.inspiration: 研究假设：保留Qwen3+IBQ状态与词表，复现MASK、generic DFM、FUDOKI metric、URSA path，再讨论2×2 block及语义入口。不能把“使用metric”或“AR转离散flow”单独视为未被探索的创新。
resources.experiment: 固定codec、主干、数据、参数与训练/采样FLOPs，只切换corruption/path；先统一clean-ID预测head，再另比较head或rate参数化。测反复重写率、错误token恢复、coverage、OCR/DocVQA/TextVQA、GenEval及显存/吞吐；test-time scaling计全候选与评分成本。
resources.state: text/image生成在离散ID空间，metric-induced categorical probability path允许非MASK替换与纠错；velocity指类别跳转率，不是ELF embedding欧氏速度。理解输入仍用SigLIP连续feature，生成用LlamaGen 16384码本，非共享单codec。
resources.objective: 离散flow matching通过kinetic-optimal velocity定义逆向采样，预测clean类别分布以构建离散更新。和URSA同属metric-aware离散路线，但具体path、rate与初始化不同；不能直接宣称是同一算法。
resources.decoding: Janus-1.5B初始化，改full attention与logit shifting，迭代并行采样可修改既有token。文本词表102400，图像16384；无直接Qwen3移植实证。精确训练总FLOPs与统一NFE需按论文/配置复核，本条不猜测。
resources.sharing: 共用Janus式LLM主干，理解SigLIP与生成VQ encoder/decoder解耦，text/image词表及输出适配不等于绑同head。应归“离散输出UMM”，不归“理解生成全共享离散视觉入口”。与ELF对照先固定codec和预算。
resources.open: 官方推理、理解/生成示例、评测代码与HF模型链接公开；完整训练数据及训练流水线是否全部复现本次未验证。精读path/rate推导、Janus转换与附录，先复现最邻近端点再写ICML novelty。

english.summary: Initializes from AR Janus-1.5B and adapts to full attention/discrete flow matching. Metric-induced paths and kinetic-optimal velocities enable bidirectional context and iterative correction,beyond pure masking. A particularly close URSA-related work.
english.why: Essential prior art if the ICML contribution involves metric paths,AR/Qwen adaptation or revisable tokens. Separate prior path/rate parameterizations from new shared-state,local-head or efficiency contributions.
english.inspiration: Hypothesis: keep Qwen3+IBQ IDs/vocabulary fixed and reproduce MASK,generic DFM,FUDOKI metric and URSA paths before adding2x2 blocks or semantic entrances. Metric use and AR-to-discrete-flow adaptation alone are not unexplored novelty.
english.state: Discrete text/image generation IDs with metric-induced categorical paths permitting non-MASK replacement. Velocity means class-transition rates,not ELF Euclidean embedding velocity. Understanding still uses SigLIP features; generation uses a16384-code LlamaGen codec,so no single shared visual codec.
english.objective: Discrete flow matching constructs sampling with kinetic-optimal rates from predicted clean categories. Like URSA it is metric-aware,but path,rate and initialization details differ; they are not interchangeable algorithms.
english.decoding: Janus-1.5B initialization,full attention/logit shifting and parallel revisable sampling. Text vocabulary102400,image vocabulary16384. No direct Qwen3 transfer experiment. Complete training FLOPs/common NFE need configuration-level verification rather than guessed values.
english.sharing: Shared Janus-style language backbone,but separate SigLIP understanding and VQ generation paths. Vocabulary/output adapters do not imply tied heads. Classify as discrete-output UMM,not fully shared discrete visual-input UMM. Fix codecs/budgets before ELF comparisons.
english.experiment: Fix codec,backbone,data,parameters and train/sample FLOPs; vary corruption/path with a common clean-ID head,then independently vary head/rate parameterization. Report rewrite/error-correction rates,coverage,OCR/DocVQA/TextVQA,GenEval,memory and throughput. Count all test-time candidates/scorers.
english.open: Official inference,understanding/generation examples,evaluation code and HF model link public. Complete training pipeline/data reproducibility not verified. Read path/rate derivations,Janus conversion and appendix before positioning ICML novelty.

resources.title: Muddit: Liberating Generation Beyond Text-to-Image with a Unified Discrete Diffusion Model
resources.paradigm: Pretrained Visual MDM / Shared Discrete Denoising / Text Decoder
resources.summary: 从强T2I Meissonic出发，给MM-DiT增加轻量文本decoder，联合文本与图像离散去噪，完成T2I、I2T和视觉问答。与LLM出发的MMaDA互补，说明“统一”可以从视觉先验扩展，而非必须从语言主干开始。
resources.why: 是离散UMM必须包含的视觉生成器初始化端点。Qwen3+IBQ的理解优势与Muddit继承的T2I优势来自不同预训练资源；若不记录这些资源，模型横向分数无法证明某个离散目标更优。
resources.inspiration: 研究假设：固定Qwen3/IBQ时，先比较是否加入图像生成teacher蒸馏，再切MASK/URSA，避免同时引入视觉先验和新path。文本decoder轻量化也提示局部head容量可能独立于全局共享主干。
resources.experiment: 固定同一IBQ、图文数据、参数/FLOPs，做语言checkpoint初始化/视觉teacher辅助×MASK/metric path的控制；所有预训练teacher FLOPs单列。测理解OCR、生成glyph、GenEval、语言能力、code共现、采样步数与显存；原Meissonic仅作资源不同的参考，不冒充严格控制。
resources.state: VQ图像ID与文本token均以离散target恢复；输入分别经image encoder/CLIP text embedding进入MM-DiT，另有文本readout。内部连续embedding不等于连续latent diffusion，文本和图像仍有不同codec。
resources.objective: 统一masked discrete denoising，以clean-token logits/交叉熵恢复被mask位置；预训练T2I视觉先验与文本head共同适配。无ELF velocity/average velocity，也非URSA uniform metric noise。
resources.decoding: cosine masking schedule迭代并行恢复，论文默认64 sampling steps，T2I/I2T的CFG分别9.0/1.5。训练先8M图文再1M instruction，文本最长77token、图像512²；完整训练总FLOPs本次未核验，不外推到长文档/OCR。
resources.sharing: MM-DiT共享跨模态去噪计算，图像codec、CLIP text输入和轻量文本输出仍分开；不是单一全绑权LLM。可作为共享程度轴的端点；无法直接把Meissonic初始化等同Qwen3/AR权重转换。
resources.open: 官方模型/推理/训练相关代码及HF Muddit链接可访问；部分训练数据为internal，不能称全数据可复现。精读初始化、shared space与sampling，区分mask目标和预训练资源。

english.summary: Starts from pretrained Meissonic T2I MM-DiT,adds a lightweight text decoder and jointly denoises discrete text/image targets for T2I,I2T and VQA. Complements LLM-initialized MMaDA by growing unification from visual priors.
english.why: A necessary visual-generator-initialized discrete UMM baseline. Qwen3 understanding and Muddit T2I strengths inherit different resources; final scores without accounting for pretraining cannot establish objective superiority.
english.inspiration: Hypothesis: with Qwen3/IBQ fixed,first isolate visual-teacher distillation,then compare MASK/URSA paths. A lightweight text decoder also motivates separating local-head capacity from global-backbone sharing.
english.state: VQ image IDs and text tokens are discrete recovery targets. Image encoding and CLIP text embeddings feed MM-DiT with separate text readout. Continuous internal embeddings do not make this continuous-latent diffusion; modality codecs remain distinct.
english.objective: Masked discrete denoising predicts clean-token logits/CE at masked positions while adapting visual priors and text heads. Neither ELF velocity/average velocity nor URSA uniform metric corruption.
english.decoding: Parallel iterative recovery with cosine masking. Default64sampling steps;T2I/I2T CFG9.0/1.5. Training uses8M paired samples then1M instruction samples,77-token text and512² images. Full training FLOPs unverified; these settings do not establish long-document/OCR performance.
english.sharing: Shared MM-DiT denoising with separate image codec,CLIP text inputs and lightweight text output. Not a fully tied single-LLM architecture. Meissonic initialization is not direct Qwen3/AR conversion; compare sharing boundaries explicitly.
english.experiment: Fix IBQ,data,parameters/FLOPs; cross language-checkpoint initialization/visual-teacher assistance with MASK/metric paths. Account for teacher pretraining separately. Measure OCR,glyph rendering,GenEval,language retention,code co-occurrence,NFE and memory. Original Meissonic is a resource-mismatched reference,not a strict control.
english.open: Official implementation with inference/training components and HF model link accessible. Some data are internal; full-data reproducibility is not established. Read initialization,shared-space and sampling sections; separate masked objectives from inherited visual resources.

resources.title: Lumina-DiMOO: An Omni Diffusion Large Language Model for Multi-Modal Generation and Understanding
resources.paradigm: Fully Discrete Masked UMM / dLLM Initialization / ML-Cache
resources.summary: 以离散dLLM统一图文理解、T2I、编辑、inpainting与主体生成，采用预测—采样—remask，并用Max-Logit Cache复用稳定计算。将tokenizer选择、多阶段数据、离散目标和cache分别讨论，才能读懂其效率来源。
resources.why: 是比早期MMaDA/UniDisc更完整的离散UMM任务覆盖端点，也是当前IBQ/MaskGIT路线的高相关基线。生成、编辑和理解同时改善不自动证明双向知识迁移，需要相同实体/概念的交叉任务控制。
resources.inspiration: 研究假设：在Qwen3+IBQ上先保留标准masked更新，只加基于logit稳定性的cache，并检查OCR位置是否比背景更晚稳定；再独立比较URSA非mask更新。不要将MIGM shortcut在本模型上的加速误认为模型本体的新生成范式。
resources.experiment: 固定主干、IBQ、数据、参数/FLOPs，先比较MASK与URSA；各自分别打开/关闭cache并匹配有效forward次数。报OCR/DocVQA/TextVQA、生成文字、GenEval、编辑背景/身份保持、code coverage、NFE/延迟/显存，额外做cache stale-error与稀有ID分桶。
resources.state: 图像离散视觉code与text IDs串接，由预训练dLLM适配；corruption为mask而不是Gaussian VAE噪声。图像重建codec独立于语言tokenizer；必须按最终配置核对codebook与resolution，不能只看总模型名。
resources.objective: clean-token categorical/logit预测，mask恢复与remask；cache只改变计算复用，不把目标改成embedding velocity。与URSA差异在forward path及token可修正方式；ELF为连续空间外部对照。
resources.decoding: 图像全局并行迭代，文本按block生成；论文文本理解设置block256、128 sampling steps。ML-Cache额外约2倍加速属于配置相关结果，应计cache命中率与误差；具体各T2I配置NFE、总训练FLOPs需逐配置核对。
resources.sharing: 共享dLLM图文语义计算与离散概率过程，视觉codec和text tokenizer分开；不意味着统一像素重建head。初始化预训练dLLM，直接从Qwen3 AR转入需要独立适配实验；固定主干后才可比较mask与metric path。
resources.open: 官方仓库含实现、使用说明及HF模型链接，论文声明代码/checkpoints公开；所有训练数据与各阶段权重本次未逐项运行核验。精读foundation tokenizer、训练阶段和ML-Cache；归历史补录。

english.summary: A discrete dLLM unifies understanding,T2I,editing,inpainting and subject-driven generation,with predict-sample-remask decoding and Max-Logit Cache. Separate codec choice,multistage data,discrete objectives and caching when interpreting efficiency.
english.why: A broader task-coverage discrete UMM endpoint beyond early MMaDA/UniDisc and a close IBQ/MaskGIT baseline. Better understanding/editing/generation does not alone establish bidirectional knowledge transfer; test matched entities/concepts.
english.inspiration: Hypothesis: first retain standard masked updates on Qwen3+IBQ and isolate logit-stability caching,checking whether OCR settles later than background. Then compare URSA updates independently. MIGM shortcut acceleration on this model is not a new model-wide generation paradigm.
english.state: Discrete visual codes and text IDs processed by an adapted pretrained dLLM; masked rather than Gaussian VAE corruption. Visual reconstruction codec differs from the language tokenizer; audit final codebook/resolution configurations rather than inferring them from a model name.
english.objective: Clean categorical/logit prediction with recovery/remasking. Caching reuses computation without changing targets into embedding velocity. Compared with URSA,the forward path and revision process differ; ELF is a continuous-space external control.
english.decoding: Global parallel image refinement and blockwise text generation. A reported understanding setup uses256-token blocks/128sampling steps. Approximately2x ML-Cache speedup is configuration-dependent; count hit rates/errors. T2I NFE/full training FLOPs need per-configuration verification.
english.sharing: Shared dLLM semantic computation/discrete formulation,but separate visual codec and text tokenizer,not one pixel-reconstruction head. Starts from a pretrained dLLM; direct Qwen AR adaptation needs its own experiment. Fix the backbone before path comparisons.
english.experiment: Fix backbone,IBQ,data,parameters/FLOPs; compare MASK and URSA,then independently enable caching under equal effective forwards. Report OCR/DocVQA/TextVQA,generated text,GenEval,editing background/identity,coverage,NFE,latency and memory; audit stale-cache error and rare-ID bins.
english.open: Official implementation,usage instructions and HF links accessible; paper announces code/checkpoints. Complete data and every training-stage checkpoint were not run-verified. Read tokenizer,training stages and ML-Cache; historical backfill.

resources.title: MMaDA-Parallel: Multimodal Large Diffusion Language Models for Thinking-Aware Editing and Generation
resources.summary: 图文响应在共同去噪轨迹中并行恢复，而非先固定文字CoT再生成图像；ParaRL沿轨迹约束语义一致。A/M两版本使用不同视觉tokenizer，不能把二者最终差异只归因到同一并行算法。
resources.why: 如果离散UMM论文声称联合文本—图像生成更能纠错或统一推理，这是一项关键近邻。它提醒需要测图文相互影响，而不只是共享Transformer或最终图像分数。
resources.inspiration: 研究假设：Qwen3+IBQ中比较先text后image与joint-mask，保持同一CoT数据和head；干预文字计划中一个对象/关系，观察后续视觉token是否改变，以及图像证据能否反向修正错误文字。
resources.experiment: 固定Qwen3、IBQ、数据、参数与训练/总采样FLOPs，比较顺序CoT、joint MASK、joint URSA；再单独加ParaRL。报Output Alignment、独立GenEval/文字OCR、CoT证据忠实性、code palette与理解benchmark；计全部文字block和image去噪调用，不只计算图像步数。
resources.state: text IDs与离散image IDs以sentinel/task tags交错，在双向上下文中联合MASK恢复；M版本MAGVIT-v2，A版本Amused-VQ。内部embedding连续不等于continuous diffusion。
resources.objective: 联合mask clean-token预测与SFT，ParaRL在抽样去噪状态上给语义reward；不是ELF velocity监督，也非URSA metric corruption。奖励一致性不等于真实CoT忠实性，需反事实证据测试。
resources.decoding: 两模态轨迹并行交互，但文本仍可block/semi-AR；官方A示例image64、text128steps、文本block32，不应直接称单一64NFE。8B A/M checkpoints；完整训练FLOPs和各reward调用预算本次未核验。
resources.sharing: 同一离散multimodal去噪骨干及上下文，image codec/text tokenizer仍不同；A与M不是同codec公平对照。基于MMaDA适配，不能把继承能力当成Qwen3 AR→diffusion转换实证。
resources.open: 官方A/M实现、两种HF权重和A训练代码可访问；Apache-2.0仓库许可。README说明真人/真实照片OOD尚未充分探索，训练数据完整性需另核验。精读parallel schedule、ParaRL与ParaBench。

english.summary: Text/image responses co-evolve during denoising rather than fixing textual CoT before image generation. ParaRL promotes trajectory-level semantic consistency. A/M variants use different image codecs; their differences are not an isolated parallel-algorithm comparison.
english.why: Key prior art for claims about joint text-image correction or unified reasoning. Test reciprocal influence rather than inferring unification from shared Transformer weights or final image scores.
english.inspiration: Hypothesis: on fixed Qwen3+IBQ,compare text-then-image and joint masking with the same CoT data/heads. Intervene on one planned object/relation and test visual change; test whether image evidence corrects erroneous text in the reverse direction.
english.state: Sentinel/task-tagged text and image IDs jointly masked under bidirectional context. M uses MAGVIT-v2,A uses Amused-VQ. Continuous embeddings inside the network are not continuous diffusion states.
english.objective: Joint masked clean-token prediction/SFT plus ParaRL semantic rewards on sampled denoising states. Neither ELF velocity nor URSA metric corruption. Reward consistency is not proof of CoT faithfulness; require counterfactual evidence tests.
english.decoding: Cross-modal trajectories interact in parallel,but text may remain block/semi-AR. Official A example:image64steps,text128steps,block32; not a single64NFE system. Two8B checkpoints; full training FLOPs/reward budgets not verified.
english.sharing: Joint discrete denoising backbone/context,with distinct image codec and text tokenizer. A/M are not same-codec controls. Adapted from MMaDA; inherited capability is not evidence of direct Qwen3 AR-to-diffusion conversion.
english.experiment: Fix Qwen3,IBQ,data,parameters and total train/sample FLOPs; compare sequential CoT,joint MASK and joint URSA,then add ParaRL separately. Measure Output Alignment,independent GenEval/text OCR,CoT evidence faithfulness,palette and understanding. Count every text block/image update,not image steps alone.
english.open: Official A/M implementation,two HF checkpoints and A training code accessible; repository Apache-2.0. README notes limited exploration of human-face/real-photo OOD inputs. Full data completeness unverified. Read parallel schedules,ParaRL and ParaBench.

resources.title: Omni-Diffusion: Unified Multimodal Understanding and Generation with Masked Discrete Diffusion
resources.summary: 以mask-based离散diffusion统一文本、图像、语音的any-to-any理解与生成；tail-pad masking处理变长，position penalty抑制图像重复布局，special-token pre-infilling辅助语音对话。它覆盖Omni扩展，但不是“任何模态同一个物理tokenizer”。
resources.why: ICML2026已发表的全离散Omni近邻，离散UMM工作不能只引用AR与图像mask而漏掉这一扩展。对Qwen3+IBQ，position penalty和长度策略也是应固定的解码控制变量。
resources.inspiration: 研究假设：先限图文，固定IBQ后测position penalty是否减少top/bottom重复而伤害OCR排版；独立扫描tail-pad长度策略，避免把可变输出长度收益误算metric path。多帧威胁与语音告警可作为后续扩展，不宣称原文验证该任务。
resources.experiment: 固定Qwen3、IBQ、数据、参数/FLOPs，比较MASK与URSA各自有无位置惩罚/尾部pad策略；报重复图案、文字行顺序、OCRBench/DocVQA/TextVQA、生成文字、GenEval、长度EOS校准、NFE/显存。三模态实验另固定语音codec与数据，计全部codec成本。
resources.state: text IDs、MAGVIT-v2图像离散code、speech tokenizer离散IDs组成joint token空间；图像downsample16、codebook8192。各模态codec不同，MASK corruption与连续VAE diffusion分开。
resources.objective: 统一clean-token categorical去噪，以mask-based probability formulation建模联合分布；tail-pad是训练mask策略，position penalty是采样调度，不是embedding/noise/velocity或average velocity目标。
resources.decoding: 双向并行迭代unmask，输出长度由pad/EOS策略处理；position penalty约束早期图像位置，speech预填special tokens。三阶段渐进训练，batch128/max3072tokens；统一NFE与完整FLOPs本次未核验，不能将多模态序列预算当图像预算。
resources.sharing: joint dLLM跨模态共享语义计算与离散去噪过程，但MAGVIT/语音/text tokenizer、decoder与词表区间不同。是否绑权每个head需看实现，本文不推断“全共享”。与URSA差forward path，与ELF差状态空间。
resources.open: 官方项目、ICML2026 PMLR论文、代码仓库和HF模型链接可访问；全训练数据与所有modality配置未逐项运行复现。精读tail-pad、position penalty和any-to-any边界，列为核心历史补录。

english.summary: Mask-based discrete diffusion supports any-to-any text,image and speech understanding/generation. Tail-pad masking handles length,position penalties reduce repeated image layouts,and special-token pre-infilling assists speech. Omni unification does not mean one physical tokenizer.
english.why: A published ICML2026 all-discrete Omni neighbor that should accompany AR and image-mask related work. For Qwen3+IBQ,position/length heuristics are separate decoding controls,not hidden paradigm advantages.
english.inspiration: Hypothesis: first restrict to text/images and fixed IBQ; test whether position penalties reduce top/bottom repetition while harming OCR layout. Vary tail-pad lengths independently from metric paths. Speech threat alerts are a future extension,not a validated task in this paper.
english.state: Joint text IDs,MAGVIT-v2 image IDs and speech IDs. Image downsampling16/codebook8192; modality codecs differ. Mask corruption is distinct from continuous VAE diffusion.
english.objective: Unified categorical clean-token denoising models the joint masked distribution. Tail-pad changes training masks;position penalties change sampling order. Neither is an embedding/noise/velocity/average-velocity objective.
english.decoding: Bidirectional parallel unmasking with pad/EOS length handling,image position penalties and speech special-token prefill. Three-stage progressive training,batch128,max3072tokens. Common NFE/full FLOPs unverified; multimodal sequence budgets are not image-only budgets.
english.sharing: A joint dLLM shares semantic computation/discrete denoising,but text,image/speech codecs,decoders and vocabulary regions differ. Head tying requires implementation audit,not an all-shared assumption. Different forward path from URSA,different state space from ELF.
english.experiment: Fix Qwen3,IBQ,data,parameters/FLOPs; compare MASK/URSA with and without position penalties/tail-pad policies. Report repeated patterns,text-line order,OCRBench,DocVQA,TextVQA,text rendering,GenEval,EOS calibration,NFE and memory. For three modalities,fix speech codecs/data and include every codec cost.
english.open: Official project,ICML2026 PMLR paper,repository and HF links accessible. Complete data and all modality configurations were not run-reproduced. Read tail-pad,position penalty and any-to-any boundaries; core historical backfill.

resources.title: Lavida-O: Elastic Large Masked Diffusion Models for Unified Multimodal Understanding and Generation
resources.paradigm: Elastic MoT / Masked Discrete Outputs / Continuous Understanding Input
resources.summary: 把LaViDa理解模型扩展到1024px生成、编辑、grounding与交错图文，Elastic-MoT连接大理解分支与轻量生成分支；配合token compression、universal text conditioning和stratified sampling。离散生成并不代表理解视觉入口同样离散。
resources.why: 是MoT/Router与离散UMM交叉的直接相关工作，不能只读单骨干MMaDA。对Qwen3+IBQ，需要区分“生成ID离散”“输入视觉离散”“主干全共享”三个声明，避免把分支效率错归统一概率模型。
resources.inspiration: 研究假设：固定IBQ与Qwen3，比较单共享stream和固定Elastic-MoT分支，再比较learned Router；所有分支计总参数与激活。理解入口保持连续semantic或改IBQ是第二条轴，glyph/DocVQA不能由通用理解均值替代。
resources.experiment: 固定主干/codec/数据与有效训练FLOPs，分开比较共享单stream、固定分支MoT、动态Router；每结构各用MASK/URSA。报OCRBench/DocVQA/TextVQA、grounding、生成文字、GenEval、branch梯度冲突、总参数/active FLOPs/显存与NFE。planning/reflection另加相同候选和judge预算。
resources.state: 理解输入沿LaViDa使用SigLIP连续semantic embeddings，输出文本为离散masked IDs；视觉生成输出离散image IDs。因此归离散输出UMM，不归全离散输入、单codec共享UMM；内部连续embedding不是ELF运输。
resources.objective: MASK-based clean-token categorical预测，Elastic-MoT改变计算共享；planning/reflection和采样策略是额外机制。不是URSA metric corruption，也非continuous Flow velocity目标。
resources.decoding: 从mask序列逐步恢复，stratified sampling等控制质量/预算，token compression降低生成计算。理解分支/生成分支规模和推理频率需共同计账；具体任务NFE、训练总FLOPs本次未核验，不外推论文速度到Qwen3。
resources.sharing: 大理解与轻生成Transformer分支通过Elastic-MoT耦合，非全部层/FFN同权；理解SigLIP与生成codec不同，输出头不应默认绑权。继承LaViDa预训练能力，直接Qwen3初始化与IBQ适配仍需验证。
resources.open: Adobe官方仓库含llava/scripts/eval、推理notebook、checkpoint下载与训练说明；模型和代码为Adobe Research License，不能泛称宽松商业开源。精读Elastic-MoT、token compression和采样，作为离散输出/混合输入边界案例。

english.summary: Extends LaViDa understanding to1024px generation,editing,grounding and interleaved text/images. Elastic-MoT couples a large understanding branch with a smaller generation branch,plus compression,universal text conditioning and stratified sampling. Discrete generation does not imply discrete visual inputs.
english.why: Direct prior art at the intersection of MoT/routing and discrete UMM. Distinguish discrete generated IDs,discrete understanding inputs and fully shared backbones; branch efficiency is not automatically a unified-probability-model gain.
english.inspiration: Hypothesis: fix IBQ/Qwen3,compare a shared stream with fixed Elastic-MoT branches before learned routing. Count total parameters/activations. Continuous-semantic versus IBQ understanding inputs form a separate axis; glyph/DocVQA cannot be replaced by average understanding scores.
english.state: Understanding retains continuous SigLIP semantic embeddings,with masked discrete text outputs; image generation predicts discrete image IDs. Classify as discrete-output UMM with mixed inputs,not fully discrete inputs or one shared codec. Internal embeddings are not ELF transport.
english.objective: Masked categorical clean-token prediction; Elastic-MoT changes computation sharing. Planning/reflection and sampling are additional mechanisms,not URSA metric corruption or continuous Flow velocity objectives.
english.decoding: Iterative masked recovery with stratified sampling and compressed generation tokens. Count both branches and their invocation frequencies. Task-specific NFE/full training FLOPs unverified; reported speed does not establish Qwen3 performance.
english.sharing: Large understanding/small generation Transformer branches are coupled rather than fully tied across layers/FFNs. SigLIP understanding and generative codecs differ; do not assume tied output heads. LaViDa inheritance is not a demonstrated direct Qwen3/IBQ conversion.
english.experiment: Fix backbone,codec,data and effective train FLOPs; compare shared stream,fixed MoT and dynamic routing,each under MASK/URSA. Report OCRBench,DocVQA,TextVQA,grounding,text rendering,GenEval,branch-gradient conflict,total/active parameters,FLOPs,memory and NFE. Add planning/reflection only with matched candidate/judge budgets.
english.open: Adobe official repository includes implementation,evaluation,inference notebook,checkpoint downloads and training instructions. Code/model use Adobe Research License,not assumed permissive commercial open source. Read Elastic-MoT,compression and sampling as a discrete-output/mixed-input boundary case.

resources.title: Sparse-LaViDa: Sparse Multimodal Discrete Diffusion Language Models
resources.paradigm: Masked Discrete UMM / Register Tokens / Dynamic Truncation
resources.summary: 在LaViDa-O的masked discrete UMM上动态截断当前不必显式处理的MASK位置，以register tokens压缩其信息，再用匹配截断行为的训练attention mask避免train/inference错位。它改变活跃token计算，而不是减少原图ID词表或发明新codec。
resources.why: 直接对应2×2 folding、稀疏token和局部解码的效率论证。若ICML工作减少Qwen3视觉计算，必须区分永久压缩token与推理时临时省略MASK；两者可在相同IBQ和序列预算下作为不同控制端点。
resources.inspiration: 研究假设：保留IBQ原始网格，按去噪阶段只展开高风险/OCR/边界位置，register概括其他MASK；最终恢复所有原ID。与固定2×2 merge比较时，单独核算register、位置编码与恢复head，不能将缩短序列当免费。
resources.experiment: 固定Qwen3、IBQ、训练数据/FLOPs、输出分辨率与NFE，比较dense MDM、固定folding、Sparse-LaViDa式动态截断；再在相同活跃token预算切MASK/URSA。报glyph/稀有code、OCRBench/DocVQA/TextVQA、GenEval、编辑/inpainting、总active-token×layer、峰值显存及真实延迟。
resources.state: 生成仍是离散visual/text IDs及MASK；被截断位置由少量连续hidden register概括，最后仍恢复完整token图，不形成新的merged ID。理解入口继承LaViDa-O连续SigLIP，不能归全离散输入/输出同codec。
resources.objective: 保持masked clean-token离散去噪目标，增加与稀疏采样一致的attention参数化和register训练。不是ELF embedding velocity，也不是URSA metric kernel；目标改进和token计算调度应分开比较。
resources.decoding: 每步动态保留/截断任意位置，不限左到右block；特殊register代替未处理MASK，双向条件仍可用于编辑。需要稀疏适配SFT，不是完全training-free drop。官方示例register64/64、groups25/25；统一NFE/完整FLOPs本次未核验。
resources.sharing: 沿用LaViDa-O elastic理解/生成分支、分离codec与head边界；新增register和attention mask改变参数/激活，不等于全层共享或同head。可作为AR/URSA/ELF之外计算调度参考，但只有同目标/预算才是严格控制。
resources.open: 官方adobe-research/Sparse-LaViDa已含demo_sparse_lavida.py、稀疏SFT脚本和HF checkpoint链接，不再只依赖项目页旧placeholder。代码/模型为Adobe Research License；全数据及所有权重未逐项运行复现。精读稀疏参数化/attention一致性与延迟测量。

english.summary: Dynamically truncates redundant MASK positions in LaViDa-O,using register tokens to summarize them and a training mask matched to sparse inference. Changes active-token computation rather than visual vocabulary or codec.
english.why: Direct efficiency prior art for2x2 folding,sparse tokens and local decoding. Distinguish permanent token compression from temporarily omitted MASK positions; compare them with the same IBQ grid and compute budgets.
english.inspiration: Hypothesis: preserve the original IBQ grid,expand OCR,boundary and high-risk positions by denoising stage,and summarize other MASK slots with registers. Restore every original ID. Count registers,position encodings and recovery heads when comparing fixed2x2 merging.
english.state: Generation remains discrete text/image IDs and MASK. Continuous hidden registers summarize omitted positions; full ID maps are eventually restored without new merged IDs. Understanding inherits LaViDa-O continuous SigLIP inputs,not a fully shared discrete codec.
english.objective: Retains masked categorical clean-token denoising,with sparse-consistent attention/register training. Neither ELF velocity nor URSA metric kernels. Separate objective changes from active-token scheduling.
english.decoding: Dynamic arbitrary-position truncation avoids mandatory left-to-right blocks,retaining bidirectional editing conditions. Requires sparse-adaptation SFT rather than training-free dropping. Official flags use64/64register tokens and25/25groups;common NFE/full FLOPs unverified.
english.sharing: Inherits LaViDa-O elastic branches and separate codec/head boundaries. Registers/masks change parameters and activations,not complete layer/head sharing. A computation-scheduling reference; strict controls require matching targets and budgets.
english.experiment: Fix Qwen3,IBQ,data/train FLOPs,resolution and NFE; compare dense MDM,fixed folding and dynamic truncation. Then vary MASK/URSA under equal active-token budgets. Measure glyph/rare-code retention,OCRBench,DocVQA,TextVQA,GenEval,editing/inpainting,active-token-layer counts,peak memory and latency.
english.open: Official adobe-research/Sparse-LaViDa now includes demo_sparse_lavida.py,sparse-SFT scripts and an HF checkpoint link,not just the project page’s old placeholder. Adobe Research License for code/model. Full data/every checkpoint not run-reproduced. Read sparse parameterization,attention consistency and latency protocols.

resources.title: Gestalt: Large Multimodal Interplay Model
resources.paradigm: IBQ Discrete UMM / Interplay Tokens / Partitioned Transformer
resources.summary: 以离散diffusion和interplay-partitioned架构组织模态内学习、跨模态对齐和协同，learnable interplay tokens承担跨模态交换。官方模型依赖IBQ-Tokenizer-16384，是与当前IBQ离散UMM最直接的新近邻之一。
resources.why: 若工作涉及共享离散视觉表示、模态信息路由或理解生成相互促进，不能漏掉Gestalt。它也明确指出VQ压缩可能丢失理解证据，适合将OCR可读性和共享语义入口作为独立贡献轴。
resources.inspiration: 研究假设：固定Qwen3+IBQ，对比普通full attention、固定分区+interplay tokens、learned Router；同时做只改语义入口、不改MASK/URSA的实验。将code palette与glyph保真纳入过滤，避免用合成teacher替代真实证据。
resources.experiment: 固定IBQ、Qwen3、数据、参数/FLOPs，先比较互通方式，再独立切AR/MASK/URSA。报跨任务concept transfer、OCRBench/DocVQA/TextVQA、生成文字OCR、GenEval、code coverage、路由/activation成本；对多帧威胁保留遮挡前身份与关键OCR并做帧删除。
resources.state: text IDs和IBQ16384视觉ID的统一序列，masked discrete生成；理解也通过离散视觉表示。网络连续embedding与interplay hidden不是ELF的连续运输状态，不能仅凭hidden连续重新分类。
resources.objective: joint masked prediction与conditional masked prediction，再interplay-oriented SFT；categorical clean-token/logit监督。与URSA差在corruption/path，和ELF差在离散状态与目标；不把数据课程作用混算生成范式。
resources.decoding: 双向离散恢复，Transformer按zone控制跨模态交换；官方配置8B+0.6B、32层、4096hidden，HF模型卡给最大4096token。统一NFE/完整训练FLOPs本次未核验；long-doc与视频不能直接由短序列分数外推。
resources.sharing: 共享离散token空间与主体架构，但前区有模态特定FFN/受限attention、后区协同，非所有权重全绑。IBQ codec与text tokenizer仍不同；Qwen3.8蒸馏来源或初始化细节须按具体checkpoint核查，不当作当前Qwen3适配已验证。
resources.open: 官方代码及HF权重可访问，模型卡Apache-2.0；HF当前checkpoint标continual pretraining，不等于完整SFT模型。卡列70M pretrain、8M continual、13.7M加约2.5M T2I SFT；所有数据下载/阶段权重未逐项复现。精读分区与数据质量控制。

english.summary: Discrete diffusion and an interplay-partitioned architecture organize unimodal learning,alignment and synergy,with learnable interplay tokens mediating exchange. The official model requires IBQ-Tokenizer-16384,making this a particularly close discrete-IBQ UMM neighbor.
english.why: Mandatory prior art for shared discrete visual representations,routing or reciprocal understanding/generation. It explicitly audits visual evidence lost by VQ compression,motivating separate OCR-readability and semantic-interface contributions.
english.inspiration: Hypothesis: fix Qwen3+IBQ and compare full attention,fixed partitions/interplay tokens and learned routing. Independently vary semantic entrances without changing MASK/URSA. Protect glyphs/palette;synthetic teachers do not replace real evidence.
english.state: Joint text IDs and16384-code IBQ visual IDs under masked discrete generation,including discrete visual understanding inputs. Continuous embeddings/interplay hidden states are not ELF transport variables.
english.objective: Joint/conditional masked prediction followed by interplay-oriented SFT,with categorical clean-token/logit targets. Different corruption/path from URSA and different state/target from ELF. Separate curriculum gains from modeling gains.
english.decoding: Bidirectional discrete recovery with zone-dependent exchange. Official model card:8B+0.6B,32layers,hidden4096,max4096tokens. Common NFE/full FLOPs unverified;short-context results do not establish long-doc/video capability.
english.sharing: Shared discrete space/main architecture,but modality-specific FFNs/restricted early attention and later synergy mean not all weights are tied. IBQ/text tokenizers differ. Check initialization/distillation sources per checkpoint;not a proven transfer to the user’s Qwen3 setup.
english.experiment: Fix IBQ,Qwen3,data,parameters/FLOPs;vary exchange mechanisms before AR/MASK/URSA. Report concept transfer,OCRBench,DocVQA,TextVQA,generated-text OCR,GenEval,coverage,routing/activation costs. For threats,test pre-occlusion identity/OCR and causal frame deletion.
english.open: Official code/HF checkpoint accessible;card Apache-2.0. Current HF checkpoint is continual-pretraining,not necessarily complete SFT. Card lists70Mpretrain,8Mcontinual,13.7Mplus roughly2.5MT2I SFT;all data/stage weights not reproduced. Read partitioning and evidence-quality controls.

resources.title: Best of Both Worlds: Multimodal Reasoning and Generation via Unified Discrete Flow Matching
resources.paradigm: Discrete Flow Matching / Task LoRA / Mixture-of-LoRA Router
resources.summary: 冻结backbone，分别训练理解与图像生成LoRA，再用Mixture-of-LoRA Router在离散diffusion中组合，mRef-DPO用相同条件、冻结reference policy和视觉reference对齐编辑。统一目标并不要求理解/生成占用完全相同可训练参数。
resources.why: 与离散UMM、MoT/Router及减少梯度冲突高度接近，也是ICML2026相关工作。若论文强调路由与离散flow结合，需明确与task-specific LoRA、reference-based preference alignment的区别，而不只比较旧AR。
resources.inspiration: 研究假设：Qwen3+IBQ先比较全共享adapter、固定理解/生成LoRA与动态MoRA，再独立切MASK/URSA。OCR与generation的冲突可按层/任务gradient cosine审计，不能只按总分判断“统一”。
resources.experiment: 固定codec、主干、数据、active/total参数、训练FLOPs和NFE，比较共享、分adapter、动态router；在每结构同设MASK/metric path。报理解OCR、DocVQA/TextVQA、文字生成、GenEval、concept transfer、梯度冲突、显存/延迟；mRef-DPO另计reference/teacher/偏好数据预算。
resources.state: 预训练tokenizer把图像转为离散visual IDs，与文本token进入双向模型；DFM的状态与类别跳转不同于ELF连续embedding。具体视觉codebook/理解codec共享细节本次未完整核验，不默认完全同入口。
resources.objective: 离散flow matching适配理解/生成，KL帮助保留语言能力；mRef-DPO为后续偏好对齐。论文标题的Flow不等于连续velocity MSE，亦不能无推导就视为URSA的同一metric path。
resources.decoding: 并行离散更新，route组合低秩adapter；原文4B模型及三阶段训练。统一采样步数、前向加噪核和完整训练FLOPs本次未核验，需复现配置后才做严格速度对比；Qwen迁移为实验假设。
resources.sharing: backbone冻结共享，理解/生成LoRA分开，router组合；这改变梯度与参数共享边界，非单一全绑权head结论。比较时统计所有LoRA与router参数，固定tokenizer后才可归因到生成目标。
resources.open: 官方项目页与arXiv可访问，页上Code/Checkpoint仍标coming soon，不能称可复现开源。精读adapter解耦、MoRA和mRef-DPO；所述SOTA为作者报告，不当作相同资源下的独立验证。

english.summary: Freezes the backbone,learns separate understanding/image LoRAs and composes them with a Mixture-of-LoRA router. mRef-DPO aligns edits using matched conditions,a frozen policy and visual references. Unified objectives need not share every trainable parameter.
english.why: Close ICML2026 prior art for discrete UMM,routing and gradient interference. Distinguish new contributions from task-specific LoRAs/routed discrete flows/reference preferences rather than comparing only older AR models.
english.inspiration: Hypothesis: fix Qwen3+IBQ;compare shared adapters,separate task LoRAs and dynamic MoRA before MASK/URSA. Audit layer/task gradient cosines and OCR-generation conflicts instead of relying on aggregate scores.
english.state: Pretrained image tokenizer produces discrete visual IDs alongside text tokens in a bidirectional model. Categorical flow states/jumps differ from ELF embeddings. Exact image codebook/perception-codec sharing not fully verified;do not assume identical inputs.
english.objective: Discrete flow adaptation with KL for linguistic retention,then mRef-DPO. Flow in the title does not mean continuous velocity MSE,nor establish identity with URSA metric paths.
english.decoding: Parallel discrete updates with routed low-rank adapters;paper reports a4B three-stage model. Common NFE,forward kernel and complete training FLOPs require implementation-level verification before strict speed comparisons. Qwen transfer remains proposed.
english.sharing: Frozen shared backbone,separate understanding/generation LoRAs and a composing router change trainable-sharing boundaries. Not a claim that every head is tied. Count all adapters/router and fix tokenizer before objective attribution.
english.experiment: Fix codec,backbone,data,active/total parameters,train FLOPs and NFE;compare shared,separate-adapter and routed designs under matched MASK/metric paths. Report OCR,DocVQA,TextVQA,text generation,GenEval,concept transfer,gradient conflict,memory/latency. Account separately for mRef-DPO references,teachers and preference data.
english.open: Official project/arXiv public,but Code/Checkpoint remain coming soon on the page. Read adapter decoupling,MoRA and mRef-DPO;reported SOTA is not independent equal-resource validation.

resources.title: Nemotron-Labs-Diffusion-Uni: Elastic Self-Refining Unified Diffusion LLM with Cross-Paradigm On-Policy Distillation
resources.paradigm: Elastic-MoT / Progressive Discrete Self-Refinement / Cross-Paradigm OPD
resources.summary: 以Elastic-MoT构造理解/生成任务视图，跨范式on-policy蒸馏VLM理解与continuous diffusion生成teacher；图像采用逐级corruption和intermediate mask states，使离散token能渐进commit/自修正，而非一次unmask后永不变。
resources.why: 与URSA/ELF对照和student-state蒸馏最接近的新近离散UMM之一。它直接挑战“masked模型缺乏纠错”的粗分类；若主张离散token修正能力，应比较forward state与commit机制而非只比较采样步数。
resources.inspiration: 研究假设：固定Qwen3+IBQ，比较absorbing mask、URSA metric替换、层级中间mask；再独立加入相同teacher的student-state OPD。把teacher提供的知识与self-refinement本身拆开，检查glyph/rare-code是否被蒸馏成高频palette。
resources.experiment: 固定主干/IBQ/数据/总参数与训练FLOPs，先对比三种离散corruption/commit规则；所有端点使用相同teacher预算后再加OPD。报重写/纠错率、coverage、OCRBench/DocVQA/TextVQA、生成OCR、GenEval、teacher/free-running差距、NFE/显存/延迟；计所有teacher decode与学生rollout。
resources.state: 理解输入为连续visual encoder，图像生成用离散image tokenizer；视觉corruption包含层级intermediate mask states与逐步commit，文本仍标准MDM。不是理解生成共单IBQ入口，也不是ELF连续VAE/embedding运输。
resources.objective: text masked离散目标、image self-refining discrete目标，额外跨范式on-policy蒸馏。continuous teacher的velocity不意味着student输出velocity；原文类别更新/kernel与URSA差别需按公式审计。
resources.decoding: 任务视图按需加载：理解8B、T2I为4B理解+8B生成、交错全16B；并行离散逐级恢复。不能只报8B掩盖全模型16B，亦不能把activation参数当总参数。精确共同NFE/总训练FLOPs本次未核验。
resources.sharing: Elastic理解/生成Transformer路径有共享信息接口，连续理解encoder与离散生成codec分开；三视图使用不同参数子集。AR/VLM与continuous模型为teacher而非证明同权重初始化，需单列蒸馏资源及codec差异。
resources.open: 官方NVlabs仓库含推理、SGLang、minimal_training/SFT及online OPD说明，HF nvidia/NLD-Uni可独立加载；NVIDIA LICENSE，不能默认宽松商业许可。完整预训练数据与全实验权重未运行核验，精读self-refinement与OPD。

english.summary: Elastic-MoT task views combine VLM understanding and continuous-generation teachers via cross-paradigm on-policy distillation. Progressive image corruption/intermediate mask states permit gradual token commitment and correction instead of irreversible one-shot unmasking.
english.why: Close recent discrete UMM prior art for URSA/ELF comparisons and student-state distillation. Avoid blanket claims that masked models cannot correct;compare actual forward states/commit rules rather than step counts alone.
english.inspiration: Hypothesis: on fixed Qwen3+IBQ,compare absorbing masks,URSA replacement and hierarchical masks;add identical-teacher student-state OPD separately. Isolate teacher knowledge from self-refinement,and audit glyph/rare-code collapse.
english.state: Continuous visual understanding encoder plus discrete image-generation codec. Image corruption uses hierarchical intermediate mask states/progressive commitments;text retains standard MDM. Not one shared IBQ perception/generation input or ELF continuous transport.
english.objective: Masked text/discrete self-refining image objectives plus cross-paradigm OPD. A continuous teacher’s velocity does not make the student a velocity predictor;compare categorical kernels with URSA explicitly.
english.decoding: Task-specific loading:8B understanding,4B understanding+8B generation forT2I,full16B forinterleaving. Parallel progressive recovery. Report total as well as active parameters;common NFE/full training FLOPs unverified.
english.sharing: Elastic Transformer paths exchange information but use separate continuous-understanding/discrete-generation codecs and parameter subsets. Teachers from AR/VLM/continuous families are not proof of weight initialization. Account for distillation resources separately.
english.experiment: Fix backbone,IBQ,data,total parameters and train FLOPs;first vary discrete corruption/commit rules,then add matched-teacher OPD. Measure rewrite/correction,coverage,OCRBench,DocVQA,TextVQA,text rendering,GenEval,teacher/free-running gaps,NFE,memory and latency. Count every teacher decode and student rollout.
english.open: Official NVlabs inference,SGLang,minimal SFT/online-OPD code and standalone HF nvidia/NLD-Uni accessible. NVIDIA LICENSE,not assumed permissive commercial use. Complete pretraining data/all experimental checkpoints not run-verified. Read self-refinement and OPD.

resources.title: Unified Discrete Diffusion for Simultaneous Vision-Language Generation
resources.paradigm: Unified Transition Matrix / Mutual Attention / Joint Discrete Generation
resources.summary: 早于现代UMM的大规模模型浪潮，使用统一离散transition matrix、fused embedding和mutual attention，支持T2I、I2T及图文同时生成。是joint multimodal discrete diffusion的历史基础，但不是现代通用指令VQA/OCR能力的证明。
resources.why: 为ICML相关工作补齐时间起点，避免把联合离散diffusion首次提出误写到2025/2026。对当前Qwen3+IBQ最有价值的是corruption矩阵与跨模态耦合思想，而非直接比较年代不同的最终分数。
resources.inspiration: 研究假设：在同一Qwen3+IBQ框架中比较模态独立mask与joint corruption耦合，再固定最优路径扫描共享attention。联合生成不是自动双向理解，要用图文证据干预和OCR任务实际验证。
resources.experiment: 固定主干/IBQ/数据/预算，比较独立与统一transition schedule，保持clean-token head不变；另切AR、MASK、URSA作现代端点。报T2I/I2T、joint completion、OCRBench/DocVQA/TextVQA、生成文字、code coverage及NFE/吞吐显存；原文模型只作基础思想，非同资源baseline。
resources.state: 图像离散码与文本token的联合categorical状态，统一transition matrix控制forward离散corruption；不是连续VAE或embedding Gaussian diffusion。两模态tokenizer不同，fused embedding不等于共享物理codec。
resources.objective: 统一离散逆向去噪目标预测类别/clean token并学习模态互依赖；不是ELF velocity/average velocity，也不是已证明等同URSA metric path的kernel。精确loss权重按原文配置核对。
resources.decoding: 离散reverse chain并行恢复图文，可固定一模态条件或同时生成两模态。原文不以LLM/AR初始化为贡献；训练预算、统一NFE及大型主干移植本次未核验，勿把早期small-scale结果外推Qwen3。
resources.sharing: 通过mutual attention和fused embedding建立共同建模，但保留模态词表/codec；不是现代单一LLM全绑权主干的同义词。属于foundation generation方法，不声称已覆盖所有通用理解benchmark。
resources.open: 作者项目与官方GitHub链接可访问性需在使用时再核对；原文公开，完整数据/模型下载本次未运行验证。泛读历史动机与transition/mutual attention，精读仅在研究联合corruption时；标明基础补录。

english.summary: An early foundation preceding modern large UMMs: unified discrete transition matrices,fused embeddings and mutual attention support T2I,I2T and simultaneous text-image generation. Not evidence of modern instruction-following OCR/VQA.
english.why: Completes the historical starting point for ICML related work;do not date joint multimodal discrete diffusion’s origin to2025/2026. Transition/coupling ideas matter more than comparing scores across eras.
english.inspiration: Hypothesis: within fixed Qwen3+IBQ,compare independent modality masks and coupled corruption before attention sharing. Joint generation does not automatically establish bidirectional understanding;test evidence interventions/OCR.
english.state: Joint categorical image-code/text-token states under a unified corruption matrix,not continuous VAE/embedding diffusion. Modality tokenizers differ;fused embeddings do not imply one physical codec.
english.objective: Unified discrete reverse denoising predicts categories/clean tokens and intermodal dependencies,not ELF velocity/average velocity. Kernel identity with URSA metric paths is not established;verify exact loss weights in original configs.
english.decoding: Parallel reverse-chain recovery with one modality fixed or both generated. AR/LLM initialization is not the claimed contribution. Full budget/common NFE and large-backbone transfer unverified;do not extrapolate early small-scale results to Qwen3.
english.sharing: Mutual attention/fused embeddings link modalities while preserving their vocabularies/codecs. Not synonymous with one fully tied modern LLM. A foundational multimodal generator,not a claim to every understanding benchmark.
english.experiment: Fix backbone,IBQ,data/budget and clean-token head;vary independent/unified transition schedules. Compare modern AR,MASK and URSA separately. Measure T2I/I2T,joint completion,OCRBench,DocVQA,TextVQA,text rendering,coverage,NFE,throughput and memory. Treat original models as conceptual rather than equal-resource baselines.
english.open: Original paper public;project/official GitHub downloads should be rechecked at use. Full data/model downloads not run-verified. Skim historical motivation/transitions;deep-read for joint-corruption research. Explicit foundational backfill.
